ITEM 1 | Single piece of cooked meat-like portion, golden-brown to tan on top with darker brown patches and speckled crust, pale cream-white underside edges, slightly glossy and moist-looking, holds its shape, roughly oval mound about 6 cm long by 4 cm wide and about 2.5 cm high, sits in the center-left of a large white square plate with a small piece of greenery beneath it | 110
ITEM 2 | Fresh green salad leaves, bright green, flat and slightly ruffled, scattered in two small clusters at the left and right edges of the food piece, one about 3 cm across and one about 2 cm across, very thin, lightly wilted-looking | 4
ITEM 3 | Pale greenish-white thin strand, slightly moist, lying in a short curve under the lower right edge of the food piece, about 2 cm long and under 0.5 cm wide | 2
